sourceSentences: Upon taking fatal damage, Kog'Maw enters a zombie state for 4 seconds, becoming ghosted and gaining 10% bonus movement speed that increases up to 50% over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes to deal true damage to nearby enemies.
While under this state, Kog'Maw becomes invulnerable, untargetable, and immune to crowd control.
Kog'Maw ejects a wad of spittle in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and reduces their armor and magic resistance for 4 seconds.
A field of ooze is created in its wake for 3 seconds, slowing enemies within the area every 0.25 seconds.
Living Artillery's damage is increased by target's missing health, or instead by if the target is below 40% maximum health.
For each stack, Living Artillery's mana cost is increased by 40.
Living Artillery will not reveal stealthed champions.
The most interesting part of that ability is that your movement speed is actually ramping up from 10% bonus movement speed to 50% the longer you are running.
First, Kogma's Q cast time scales of his attack speed.
The resist shred doesn't just help you. It makes your entire team do more damage to that target.
You can press E plus Q immediately, and it won't be as noticeable. You can press E plus R to guarantee you will hit your ultimate.

Additionally, the special feature of E is that it will not do much if you stand perpendicular to the enemy. they will get through it pretty quickly. But if you stay parallel to them and cast it, they won't be able to reach you at all.
If enemy is below 40% HP, make sure to use it every time it costs 40.

For combos: start with E, then Q and ult, then turn on W and attack, adding an ult as needed. Your all-in is W and attack. Next, use E, Q, and the ultimate, continuing to attack and using the ultimate
